command:
cat > /app/meeting_scheduled.ics <<'EOF'
BEGIN:VCALENDAR
VERSION:2.0
PRODID:-//Team Scheduler//Team Planning Meeting//EN
CALSCALE:GREGORIAN
METHOD:PUBLISH
BEGIN:VEVENT
UID:team-planning-20240117@example.com
DTSTAMP:20240117T000000Z
DTSTART:20240117T110000Z
DTEND:20240117T120000Z
SUMMARY:Team Planning Meeting
DESCRIPTION:1-hour team planning meeting for Alice, Bob, and Carol.
LOCATION:Conference Room
ATTENDEE;CN=Alice;ROLE=REQ-PARTICIPANT:mailto:alice@example.com
ATTENDEE;CN=Bob;ROLE=REQ-PARTICIPANT:mailto:bob@example.com
ATTENDEE;CN=Carol;ROLE=REQ-PARTICIPANT:mailto:carol@example.com
END:VEVENT
END:VCALENDAR
EOF
python3 - <<'PY'
from datetime import datetime, time
from pathlib import Path

def parse_events(path):
    events = []
    start = end = summary = None
    for raw in Path(path).read_text().splitlines():
        line = raw.strip()
        if line == 'BEGIN:VEVENT':
            start = end = summary = None
        elif line.startswith('DTSTART:'):
            start = datetime.strptime(line.split(':', 1)[1], '%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
        elif line.startswith('DTEND:'):
            end = datetime.strptime(line.split(':', 1)[1], '%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
        elif line.startswith('SUMMARY:'):
            summary = line.split(':', 1)[1]
        elif line == 'END:VEVENT':
            events.append((start, end, summary))
    return events

calendars = {
    name: parse_events(f'/app/{name}_calendar.ics')
    for name in ('alice', 'bob', 'carol')
}

start = datetime(2024, 1, 17, 11, 0)
end = datetime(2024, 1, 17, 12, 0)

# Hard availability windows and constraints.
assert start.weekday() < 5 and end.weekday() < 5
assert start.time() >= time(9, 0) and end.time() <= time(14, 0)  # Alice
assert start.time() >= time(10, 0)                              # Bob
if start.weekday() in (1, 3):
    assert end.time() <= time(16, 30)                           # Bob Tue/Thu
assert start.time() >= time(9, 0) and end.time() <= time(17, 0) # Carol
assert not (start < datetime(2024, 1, 17, 12, 30) and end > datetime(2024, 1, 17, 12, 0))  # Carol lunch

for name, events in calendars.items():
    for busy_start, busy_end, summary in events:
        assert not (start < busy_end and end > busy_start), f'Conflict for {name}: {summary}'

out = Path('/app/meeting_scheduled.ics').read_text()
assert out.startswith('BEGIN:VCALENDAR') and out.rstrip().endswith('END:VCALENDAR')
assert 'VERSION:2.0' in out and 'PRODID:' in out
assert 'BEGIN:VEVENT' in out and 'END:VEVENT' in out
assert 'DTSTART:20240117T110000Z' in out and 'DTEND:20240117T120000Z' in out
for email in ('alice@example.com', 'bob@example.com', 'carol@example.com'):
    assert email in out
print('PASS: Team Planning Meeting scheduled 2024-01-17 11:00-12:00 UTC with no conflicts.')
PY
